natural_scope: Source-qualified biological tissues and native biological fibers, retaining the source-declared tissue or fiber identity. Cleaning, degumming, conditioning or other source-declared preparation does not alone imply purified polymer or engineered-composite identity.
exclusions: Rocks and minerals remain inorganic. Extracted lignin, formulated natural rubber, purified/processed biopolymers and unfilled polymer blends retain polymer; engineered constituent combinations retain their existing category. Biogenic feedstock alone does not establish natural tissue.
identity_policy: Existing stable catalog IDs remain authoritative unless an independently curated accepted-taxon and tissue crosswalk establishes a canonical identity key. This migration creates no taxonomy accessions or taxon/tissue assertions. Grades, preparation states, aliases and source rows do not independently establish additional material identities.
preserved_scope: Only the 10 identity category fields and 24 explicitly listed classification-prose fields change. Identity versions, identifiers, all other identity/state/property fields, grades, bibliography, reported numbers, units, uncertainty, conditions, evidence, rights and verification status are preserved.
